description: Create an Edge Assist site: AI answers for a website, grounded in its own content. Free tier: 1 site, 250 answered questions/month. Returns the sitekey and a one-line embed snippet.

index_url.description: Public URL of the content index JSON: { "pages": [{ "url", "title", "text" }] }. Can be set later.
